name: Microsoft Defender Disabled or Tampered (Windows)
description: Real-time protection turned off, exclusions added, or the Defender service disabled — via Set-MpPreference, Add-MpPreference, sc.exe, or registry writes to the Windows Defender policy keys.
query: (event.provider:"Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and event.code:"1" and process.command_line:(*DisableRealtimeMonitoring* or *"Add-MpPreference"* or *"-ExclusionPath"* or *"-ExclusionProcess"* or *"sc "*stop*WinDefend* or *"sc "*config*WinDefend*)) or (event.provider:"Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and event.code:("12" or "13") and registry.path:(*\\Windows Defender\\* and (*DisableAntiSpyware* or *DisableRealtimeMonitoring* or *\\Exclusions\\*)))
false_positives: Endpoint management tools that manage exclusions centrally — allow-list the managing process.
note:
### Triage
- Which setting changed and who changed it?
- An exclusion added just before a file write to that path is a strong staging indicator.
